About the program The demand for data-savvy professionals spans various industries, including finance, healthcare, marketing, retail, and manufacturing, where data-driven decision-making is critical to maintaining a competitive edge and driving innovation. The Associate Certificate in Business Data Management (ACDM) is designed to meet the growing need for data management skills across all industries and sectors, enhancing data literacy by providing professionals with the skills to govern and manage data quality, enabling them to leverage tools and techniques to ensure accurate and reliable data for analysis. As organizations increasingly rely on data to drive strategic decision-making, the need to ensure data integrity, privacy, and compliance has never been greater. The ACDM program prepares students to manage data as a strategic asset—harmonizing disparate systems, upholding governance standards, and enabling accurate, reliable insights that support informed decisions. Designed to meet the growing demand for data management and governance skills, this program empowers learners to thrive in a data-driven world while helping employers meet the need for innovative, competitive talent. Research from the Centre for International Governance Innovation reveals that many countries are still in the early stages of developing effective data governance frameworks, which creates significant challenges in ensuring accountability and reliability, particularly as data increasingly powers artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) systems. The ACDM program directly addresses this gap, equipping graduates with the knowledge and skills to navigate the complexities of data governance in the age of AI, thereby positioning them as valuable contributors to organizations that strive to leverage data responsibly and strategically. Who it’s for Who should apply for the Business Data Management Associate Certificate? Graduates of BCIT Business Diploma programs looking to develop knowledge and skills in Data Management and Governance. Graduates of business diploma and degree programs from other post-secondary institutions. Industry professionals looking to develop knowledge and skills in Data Management and Governance. If this sounds like you, apply today on the Entrance Requirements page. Next up Entrance Requirements

program_details_raw: Program aim The ACDM aims to equip individuals with the skills and knowledge to organize and manage data for meaningful analysis. The program focuses on data governance, quality, and integration, ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and completeness of data for impactful business outcomes. Program goals Graduates of the program will: Leverage data governance frameworks to ensure that data is utilized effectively for analytics and meets the standards of privacy, security, and ethics. Explore the critical role of data quality in contemporary business environments, learning approaches and techniques to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Recognize and enhance the quality of data in various business scenarios. Utilize advanced tools to facilitate the cleaning, storage, transformation, and integration of data from diverse sources, thereby supporting business analytics. Plan for and use data analytics for strategic business purposes. Plan for and support the evolution of the mature data organization. Program length The program can be completed in one year, based on completing two courses per term for two terms. The program must be completed within 5 years. Program delivery Blended: This program is delivered partly on campus and partly online. Program location Burnaby Campus 3700 Willingdon Avenue Burnaby, BC Distance and online learning Continue your education Graduates of this program may continue their studies to complete the BCIT Business Information Technology Management (Analytics Data Management Option) program, a 2-year, full-time (day school) program in the School of Business and Media. courses.course_overview_raw: This course explores the critical role of data quality in contemporary business environments. Students will learn various approaches and techniques for ensuring data quality and how it impacts decision-making, operational efficiency, and strategic planning within organizations. Practical applications and case studies will be used to reinforce concepts.​ Prerequisite(s): BSYS 2000 and OPMT 1130

courses.course_overview_raw: ​This course explores the fundamentals of data governance and its crucial role in enabling effective and ethical data analytics. Students will learn the principles, frameworks, and best practices for managing and governing data assets in organizations, with a focus on supporting analytics initiatives. The course combines theoretical concepts with practical applications.​ Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

courses.prerequisite_raw: No prerequisites are required for this course.
courses.course_overview_raw: ​This course introduces students to the theory of Business Data Analytics and prepares students to write the Certification in Business Data Analytics (CBDA) exam from the International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA). Prerequisite(s): No prerequisites are required for this course.

This course will introduce students to the fundamentals of data management for analytics. Students will learn how to use Microsoft Power Automate and other data management tools to collect, store, clean, and transform data. They will also learn how to integrate data from multiple sources and prepare data for analysis using various techniques. Students will have the opportunity to work with real-world datasets and build hands-on skills in data management and analysis. ​ Prerequisite(s): BABI 3000

​This course will introduce students to the concepts and techniques of data quality management (DQM) using the Python programming language. Students will learn how to use Anaconda and Python libraries most suited for DQM, such as pandas, NumPy, seaborn, and SciPy. They will learn how to assess data quality, identify data anomalies, and develop strategies for improving data quality. Students will have the opportunity to work with real-world datasets and build hands-on skills in data quality management using Python. ​ Prerequisite(s): BABI 3000 and BSYS 2065
